newsitem.title: USA: RETAIL SALES ROSE 0.6 PERCENT IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: RETAIL SALES ROSE 0.6 PERCENT IN JULY.

text.p: Sales at retail stores rose a moderate 0.6 percent last month, reflecting a broadbased improvement in all businesses except furniture, the Commerce Department said on Wednesday.

Retailers rang up a seasonally adjusted $212.08 billion in sales in July, after their June sales rose a revised 0.7 percent, slightly better than the previously reported 0.5 percent gain for that month.
